findings: Coverage and evidence remain independently visible.
Action and escalation union prevents lower-severity suppression.
Missing authority produces quarantine without a policy conclusion.
Policy authority contains no benchmark identities or case exceptions.

approval.rationale: The policy provides a general, auditable authority for concurrent assurance conditions, proportionate remediation and mandatory escalation floors before v1.6 implementation.

limitations: All identities and approvals are fictional portfolio controls.
This is not legal advice, a compliance opinion or production governance approval.
Approval does not implement, certify, freeze, execute or score v1.6.
